sufficiencyThreshold.rationale: Preserves statistical significance against noise and collusion; 5 units is insufficient for high-stakes academic claims.

antiGamingMeasures.clusterScaling: Correlated claims from one incident cluster scale to 1 aggregate unit
antiGamingMeasures.selfReviewBan: Evaluators cannot review their own submissions (SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN)
antiGamingMeasures.blindAdjudication: Initial expert assessments are blind to other evaluators
